source_quote: In December 2025, the weighted average interest rates of new corporate loans and mortgages both stood at about 3.1 percent, down 2.5 and 2.6 percentage points respectively from the second half of 2018.
The inventory overhang remains elevated at 30 months of sales, while government initiatives for inventory purchases have shown limited traction (¶45).
After more than three years of deep adjustment, the real estate market has entered a bottoming phase.
